The identity uG=vF+sC forces s^m to divide the y-resultant by UFD coprimality. Direct highest/lowest x coefficient extraction gives exact edge resultant factors. The linear x resultant gives the explicit y-eliminant. The toric volume count is 2m; the incidence graph is irreducible; a four-condition rank argument excludes generic collisions in x; Gauss primitiveness proves y irreducibility. 20 exact m=1..5 tests confirmed all leading/constant formulas, and each checked degree has a squarefree specialization; these tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof. Scope excludes non-generic degenerations.

value.rationale: The invariant is a natural boundary-escape factorization of critical-point coordinates, explicitly singled out as a computation problem in Section 6 of the 2026 logarithmic A-discriminant paper. This theorem completely solves both coordinate factor lists for an infinite Segre-Veronese scroll family. The asymmetry between edge-discriminant factors and endpoint-only factors, and multiplicity m versus 1, is structural information needed to distinguish boundary degenerations. It is not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere fixed example, although it does not solve arbitrary toric supports.
